tooltip.jaymospowers.star_chart: Read it, and the sky remembers.
message.jaymospowers.star_chart.read: A new light in the sky: %s
message.jaymospowers.star_bench.hum: It hums, and offers nothing more.
message.jaymospowers.star_bench.known: The lens hums. You already know this sky.
message.jaymospowers.star_bench.chart: A chart slides out from under the lens.
message.jaymospowers.space_unread: You have nothing to steer by.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.moon.1: Near, pale, and quiet. It lets go of things slowly.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.moon.2: Jump, and the ground forgets you for a while.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.moon.3: Bring a rope. Bring a longer rope.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.rustfall.1: Red, and heavy in the legs.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.rustfall.2: Everything weighs more, so everything falls harder.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.rustfall.3: The old plates lie in the rust. Not all of them are old.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.rustfall.4: Bring someone who trains. The weight is a teacher.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.glacia.1: A sea that forgot to move.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.glacia.2: Walk lightly. Glass keeps what it is given.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.glacia.4: Something blue sleeps under the clear places.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.cinder.1: Forge and furnace, and no one tending them.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.cinder.2: The ground drinks heat from your hunger.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.cinder.4: Bring water, or a good reason.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.maw.1: A hole in a dark that has no floor.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.maw.2: It pulls on everything. It pulls hardest near the end.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.maw.3: Wrecks drift round it. Some still remember how to be ships.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.maw.4: Do not stand at the edge to see how it looks.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.verdant.1: Green, and awake before you arrive.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.verdant.2: The water there is kind. The rest is not always.
book.jaymospowers.star_chart.verdant.4: Tread softly. It grows where you walked.
